p, k = map(int, input().split())
visited_nodes = [False] * p
cycle_total = 0

def visit_cycle(start_node):
    current_node = start_node
    while not visited_nodes[current_node]:
        visited_nodes[current_node] = True
        current_node = (current_node * k) % p

for i in range(p):
    if not visited_nodes[i]:
        cycle_total += 1
        visit_cycle(i)

answer_value = 1
for _ in range(1, cycle_total + (1 if k == 1 else 0)):
    answer_value = (answer_value * p) % 1000000007

print(answer_value)
